scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification or replication.
This synthesis read complete supplied text and all earlier image-review notes but received no image pixels. Earlier API page-call provenance reports image/text coverage of all 15 physical pages.
The supplied hash and page-call receipts were not independently recomputed or queried. No executable schema, coverage, quotation or graph validation ran in this call.

Raw legacy cells are copied from the supplied candidate. Their historical extraction and restoration claims are not independently verified here; no external immutable workbook comparison was possible.
Core membership concerns learned block-predictive procedural-scene evolution, not recurrent belief filtering or a clinically validated physical simulator.
L3 rests on selected qualitative same-origin procedural-text alternatives. Numerical robot controls are IDM targets/policy outputs, not demonstrated generator inputs.
Policy evaluation is offline command MSE. Table 2 success is generated-video completeness, not learned-policy robot execution. Demonstrated L4 is not established.
R1 and generator-component R4 are supported. Held-out actual human/clinical R2 validation, independent clinical R3 validation and prospective clinical facets are not established.
Generator maximum extent, frame cadence, recursive feedback, drift and effective horizon are unreported. Flow interpolation, video time and optimization iterations are separate coordinates.
SATA evaluation partition, source/patient/recording overlap and annotation agreement are insufficiently specified. Table 3 dashes and dataset spelling remain as reported.
The selected 56 origins come from a pool also used for IDM training. Declared holdout is component-specific, not pipeline-wide independence.
Independent scoring and surgeon guidance are both reported. Unique video allocation, blinding, agreement and rating uncertainty remain unclear.
Figure 6 axis/value mappings rely on earlier image-review notes; extracted labels alone prove occurrence, not spatial assignment. Policy-chart bar estimates are excluded.
Main synthetic-assisted policies receive more optimization steps than real-only baselines; the synthetic-data contribution is not isolated from this budget difference.
The six-policy count, Figure 14 checkpoint identity, similar Figures 12/13, unexplained SurgeWorld name, command-position semantics and uncertainty aggregation remain unresolved.
Stochastic sampling does not establish decomposition, calibration, support, privacy or safety. Ethics, safeguards, asset terms and lifecycle assurances are incompletely documented.
All 128 catalogue features have dispositions at relevant main-model or component scopes. Auxiliary configuration sets are not separately certified complete 128-feature annotations.

21 November 2026: all 15 pages including bibliography and supplementary pages reread locally. Expert reader study is explicitly linked only to the SATA generator, not the full synthetic-assisted policy composition. Qualitative same-origin prompt alternatives support functional L3, not causal identification. No numeric Figure5 rollout duration established.
